audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Tryndamere levels 2 and 3 and called level 1 Skill, while the page's own whys said Olaf owns levels 1 through 4 — the two layers of the same lane told opposite stories.
audit.why: Olaf's early kit is strictly stronger: Undertow at 1000 range slows and shreds armour, Tough It Out adds attack speed and a shield, and Berserker Rage grows his attack speed and life steal as he drops. Tryndamere has no answer until crit.
audit.corrected: Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Tryndamere, Tryndamere with ratings 3,3,3,4,5,6,7, proposed as matched pairs across both layers — the shape the mirror and the packet both give.

audit.why: Level 6 (Skill) and 2+ items (Tryndamere) were already right; first item is the genuine flip, since crit is the first thing that outruns his sustain.
audit.corrected: Ratings raised to make the flip legible instead of flat 5s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page called Olaf's W 'Vicious Strikes' and credited it with lifesteal in four places; it also claimed Ragnarok 'ignores your Mocking Shout slow', and never mentioned Reckless Swing at all.
audit.why: Riot's data names the W Tough It Out and describes it as attack speed plus a Shield — no healing. The life steal is Berserker Rage (P), scaling with his missing Health, which is why a long trade gets worse the more you hurt him. Ragnarok's text grants armour, magic resist, and immunity to disables while he keeps attacking; it says nothing about slows, so the slow-immunity claim is unsupported. Reckless Swing is true damage at 325 range on 11/10/9/8/7s, self-damaging and refunded on a kill.
audit.corrected: W renamed and re-described as a shield, life steal moved to the passive, the Ragnarok claim replaced with its actual text, and Reckless Swing's true damage written into dontsFull[1] and phases[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization recommends Plated Steelcaps and Executioner's Calling as if armour and anti-heal cover his damage.
audit.why: Reckless Swing is true damage, so armour does not reduce his most punishing button — the missingInteractions 'resistances-invalidated' rule. Anti-heal still matters, but for the passive's life steal, not for the W.
audit.corrected: Stated in dontsFull[1].d so the player knows why armour under-performs here; the item line itself was left alone because a boot swap is a build call, not a text fix.

edits.before: Spin up fury on the wave before contesting anything. Identify how Olaf contests the first waves before you commit anything.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Olaf must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Reckless Swing is true damage at 325 range on 11/10/9/8/7s — armour does nothing, and Tough It Out shields your crits.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ragnarok's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Still his: the passive scales as he takes damage, so an even trade leaves him the stronger one. Farm to your first crit item.

edits.before: Undying Rage makes you unkillable for 5 seconds — dives and coin-flip all-ins become yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Olaf's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Undying Rage stops the kill, but Ragnarok makes him immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking — your R buys the exit here, not the kill. Play it even.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Reckless Swing is true damage at 325 range — armour will not save you.

edits.before: Level 5-6 evens out — your R stops the execute but Ragnarok ignores your slow.
edits.after: Level 6 evens out — your R denies the kill, his R denies every disable.

edits.before: Olaf hard-wins early: his Q Undertow axe slow plus W Vicious Strikes lifesteal and passive Berserker Rage attack speed let him win every extended trade, and if he picks up his thrown axe the slow refreshes so you can't kite out. Do not fight him level 1-5 — farm carefully, dodge the axe by moving perpendicular, and give ground rather than dying to his sustained DPS.
edits.after: Olaf hard-wins early: Undertow (Q) slows and shreds armour at 1000 range, Tough It Out (W) is attack speed and a shield, and Berserker Rage feeds him attack speed and life steal as his health drops. Collecting his thrown axe resets Q outright, so you cannot kite out of it. Do not fight levels 1-5 — dodge the axe sideways and give ground instead of dying to his sustained damage.

edits.before: Even with R Undying Rage the fight is close, but his R Ragnarok makes him immune to your W Mocking Shout slow and gives him tenacity and armor, so don't force it — your ult stops you dying but doesn't guarantee you kill through his sustain. Play for even and farm to your item spike.
edits.after: Even with R Undying Rage the fight is close: Ragnarok grants armour and magic resist plus immunity to disables while he keeps attacking, so your ult stops you dying without guaranteeing a kill. Mocking Shout still cuts his AD, but only slows him with his back turned. Farm to your item spike.

edits.before: Levels 1 through 4 belong to Olaf — his Q axe slow, Berserker Rage attack speed and W Vicious Strikes healing crush you in any sustained trade, so respect him, dodge axes and just farm without committing.
edits.after: Levels 1 through 4 belong to Olaf — Undertow's slow, Berserker Rage's attack speed and life steal, and the Tough It Out shield crush you in any sustained trade, so dodge axes and farm without committing.

edits.before: At 5-6 it evens out: your R Undying Rage stops him executing you, but his R Ragnarok ignores your Mocking Shout slow, so avoid coin-flip all-ins and farm toward your item spike instead.
edits.after: At 5-6 it evens out: R Undying Rage stops him executing you, but Ragnarok grants him resists and disable immunity, so avoid coin-flip all-ins and farm toward your item spike instead.

edits.before: From your first crit item onward the matchup flips your way — your burst out-races his lifesteal, you kite him with Mocking Shout when Ragnarok is down, and by full items you out-duel and out-split a low-mobility bruiser.
edits.after: From your first crit item the matchup flips — your burst out-races his life steal, and Mocking Shout kites him once Ragnarok is down, though its slow only bites with his back turned. By full items you out-duel and out-split him.

edits.before: Win extended trades 1-5 with W lifesteal and attack speed
edits.after: Win extended trades 1-5 with a shield and attack speed

edits.before: Use R Ragnarok to ignore your slows and all-in
edits.after: Use R Ragnarok for disable immunity and all-in

notes: The W name error was systemic: 'Vicious Strikes' appeared as a healing ability in spikes[0], early and wants.foe[0] — Riot's current data has Tough It Out, attack speed plus a shield, with the life steal on the passive instead. I corrected the three prose instances. Kit flag noted, not asserted: Undertow (Q) carries a 'grounding — shuts off enemy dashes' flag, but Riot's text only describes damage, armour reduction and a slow. If that grounding is real it would stop Spinning Slash escaping the axe, which is a significant lane fact — listed in unverified rather than written.
